title.en: Human Poverty Index (HPI) vs Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)
title.hi: Human Poverty Index (HPI) vs Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)

rows.en: Introduced by OPHI and UNDP in 2010
rows.hi: Introduced by OPHI and UNDP in 2010

rows.en: Focuses on deprivation in three dimensions
rows.hi: Focuses on deprivation in three dimensions

rows.en: Focuses on overlapping deprivations at household level
rows.hi: Focuses on overlapping deprivations at household level

rows.en: Both move beyond income-based poverty metrics to capture human well-being.
rows.hi: Both move beyond income-based poverty metrics to capture human well-being.

clarification.en: HDI measures average achievement in development, while HPI measures the extent of deprivation in those same dimensions.
clarification.hi: HDI measures average achievement in development, while HPI measures the extent of deprivation in those same dimensions.

relationship.en: HPI acts as a negative indicator to track the shortfall in human development goals.
relationship.hi: HPI acts as a negative indicator to track the shortfall in human development goals.
